messages:
amanda: received an escalation from AcmeCorp — their indexer backfill started ~0900 UTC and now ~40% of inserts are rejected with a shape error. billing spike + customer upset. attaching logs below.

amanda: error log: `indexer: insert rejected: vector shape mismatch: expected=2048 got=1536 (model=redwood-embed-v2)`

amanda: they say they didn't change their client. backfill job is running at 2k qps.

ricardo: can you share the embed model id the client is calling and any recent model swaps? :thinking_face:

amanda: customer claims they were on `redwood-embed-v2` yesterday; we pushed `redwood-embed-v2-quant` as a recommendation yesterday but no forced swap. no reported deploys on their side.

eli: ops-bot shows a surge of `embeddings.v1` 500s at the same window — tagging infra. @ops-bot can you paste the alert?

ops-bot: [ALERT] 2024-03-05T09:12Z embeddings.v1 5xx rate increased to 4.7% (baseline 0.3%). top caller: acmecorp-backfill-job-3.

ricardo: likely scenarios: (1) client started using a different model endpoint (2) client encoding/serialization changed (3) indexer config mapping updated (schema expects 2048). we should verify the raw embedding array length from their request vs what reaches the indexer.

amanda: requested a sample request from AcmeCorp — they sent a payload with an `embedding` array len=1536. they also included an SDK version string: `acme-sdk/1.2.0`.

eli: quick repro command for support to ask customer to run:```bash
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.inference/embeddings \ 
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer <key>' \ 
  -d '{"model":"redwood-embed-v2","input":"test"}' | jq '.data[0].embedding | length'
```

tess: mitigation next steps: pause their backfill or throttle to <200 qps, and abort retries that amplify billing. also create a temporary allowlist mapping in the indexer to accept 1536 vectors into a staging table to avoid full failure while we triage.

ricardo: engineering triage plan: 1) confirm model id and sdk call path (support) 2) capture raw request/response sample (support + infra) 3) check model catalog: did `redwood-embed-v2` get recompiled/quantized to 1536-dim variant? (ml) 4) check indexer ingestion mapping and vecdb schema for shape enforcement (platform)

amanda: customer wants fast remediation — suggested short-term fix: run a transform to upsample/pad embeddings to 2048 for the backfill (we can provide a tiny lambda snippet) and then schedule a controlled backfill with dedup. they agreed to pause for 30m to test.

ricardo: if padding is used we must add a flag in the indexer to mark those rows for re-eval when/if model dims change again. otherwise we'll pollute vectors.

amanda: action items: - support: confirm sdk/model for AcmeCorp and capture sample request (due in 30m) - infra: pull request traces for embeddings.v1 09:00–09:20 UTC (due in 15m) - ml (ricardo): check model build history and dim changes (due in 1h) - platform (eli/tess): prepare staging mapping + short-term pad transform (due in 45m)

tess: also flag billing — finance may need an adjustment for the retry storm. ping finance if cost > $5k in the spike window.

amanda: updating the ticket with the mitigation steps now. I'll post update after the customer runs the curl check. :thumbsup:
